The interaction between Oprozomib and Fes/Fps is supported by a high confidence score, indicating a plausible biological relationship. The mechanism is further supported by the presence of a known inhibitor of the O-methyltransferase, suggesting that the inhibition of this enzyme could be a relevant pathway in the context of the disease.
